Vendored GraphiQL assets for suku's `vendored-graphiql` feature.

These files are the unmodified production browser builds published on npm. The build script
(`crates/suku/build.rs`) inlines them into one self-contained HTML page when the feature is
enabled. Run `./update.sh` to re-download, verify and (when changing versions) refresh them.

graphiql
  version:   4.1.2
  file:      graphiql.min.js   1066442 bytes
             sha256 867226ba8af5ce7949903fc53932f78dac9f4bfc6cc8da0fd3869b8bc6c5256b
  file:      graphiql.min.css   418449 bytes
             sha256 30487e07635d312a63f647b140d37740a73c53332b0975bf4b1fe985ca6ec885
  source:    https://unpkg.com/graphiql@4.1.2/graphiql.min.js
             https://unpkg.com/graphiql@4.1.2/graphiql.min.css
  license:   MIT, see LICENSE.graphiql.txt
  note:      graphiql 4.x is the newest line that publishes a UMD browser bundle
             (`graphiql.min.js`). 5.x and later ship ESM only, so they cannot be used
             with the script-tag bootstrap without a bundler.

The default build does not use these files; it keeps loading the unversioned unpkg URLs from
`src/http/graphiql.html`.
